Subject: Post-call recap & success criteria (POC)

Thanks again for the time this morning — good conversation. Quick recap and next steps to keep momentum toward the final readout and decision: 

1) Success criteria (attached): I’ve attached the draft "Veridian_POC_Success_Criteria.docx" we discussed. Key items:
   - 95th percentile latency < 400ms for 512-token requests under a sustained 50 RPS load
   - Mean token cost <= $0.004/token given expected prefix caching rates
   - End-to-end throughput of at least 40 reqs/s for batch inference jobs
   - No sensitive PHI persisted in logs; audit events for every request

2) Evaluation plan: you’ll run 2 weeks of evaluation traffic; we’ll provide a small sample data set (attached) and an instrumentation guide.

3) Ownership & decision process: Devon indicated Priya (CTO) will own the exec decision; you expect an internal review after our final readout. Please confirm who will attend the readout from your side (engineer + exec preferred).

4) Readout timing: proposed window is Monday 2027-05-10 between 14:00–16:00 PT. Can you confirm a 30–45 min slot for a final demo and decision discussion?

5) Next contract step: if go, we’ll prepare a short SOW + order form and route for signature (DocuSign). If you need procurement contacts now, please share.

Attachments: Veridian_POC_Success_Criteria.docx

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we lock time.

—
